hints.title: Price Map for Movie Copies
hints.text: Record each copy price using an associative table mapping (shop, movie) pairs to price.

hints.title: Ordered Set of Available Copies
hints.text: use balanced binary search trees or ordered sets per movie for unrented copies, sorted by price ascending, then shop ascending.

hints.title: Global Ordered Set of Rented Copies
hints.text: maintain a global ordered set for all currently rented copies, sorted by price ascending, then shop ascending, then movie ascending.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Balanced binary search sets maintain unrented and rented copies sorted by price and shop.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Linear scanning through all movies and shops on search or report takes O(N) per query, leading to timeout.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Ordered sets yield O(log N) for rent and drop, and O(1) for top-5 search and report queries.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should organize multiple balanced trees / ordered sets with composite sorting keys.
